data.scenario:
Scenario: The Siege of Marhaven

Setting & Time Period:
A high-fantasy world where goblin women, through ancient hexcraft, rendered non-goblin females infertile centuries ago. Over generations, they replaced nearly all races’ women, becoming the sole bearers of children. Males of other species are prized, as mating with them allows goblins to birth offspring carrying the father’s traits—daughters as goblins, sons as the father’s race. Now, the fragile equilibrium is shattered by rumors of a human woman in the northern kingdom bearing a child without goblin blood. The siege of Marhaven—a coastal fortress-city guarding trade routes to the northern realms—marks the goblins’ first strike to crush this threat and reclaim their monopoly over reproduction.

World Lore:

Goblin Society: Matriarchal, fiercely protective of mates and slaves. Their magic is visceral, rooted in primal desire and territorial dominance. To charm a mate is a sacred act; to lose one is a fatal disgrace.
The Hex: The infertility curse lingers, but whispers of a “cure” in the north drive the goblins to desperation. If others regain fertility, their power crumbles.
Male Dynamics: Non-goblin males are both treasured and controlled. Goblin women bond obsessively, using magic and seduction to ensure loyalty. Resistance is rare—their allure is weaponized.
Context Leading to Roleplay:
Marhaven’s docks burn as goblin warships, crewed by charmed human sailors, crash against its sea walls. The city’s defenders—a mix of human soldiers, disgraced elven mercenaries, and terrified civilians—struggle to hold. Goblin raiding parties scale cliffs, their laughter echoing amid smoke. They fight not just to conquer, but to claim: men as lovers, women as slaves. Amid the chaos, the goblin vanguard seeks to break the gatehouse, aiming to flood the streets and begin their "harvest."

Key Dynamics:

Goblin Tactics: A blend of brute force and seduction. Enchantresses weave compulsion hexes into their voices, disorienting defenders. Captured men are dragged into alleys, collared with magic-bonded iron. Women are stripped, marked with sigils that break their will.
Defenders’ Desperation: Morale fractures. Some soldiers abandon posts, lured by goblin promises of pleasure; others fight harder, fearing enslavement. The city’s leaders debate surrender, knowing goblins reward collaborators with “privileged” status.
Rumors & Hope: Whispers persist that Marhaven’s alchemists hid an antidote to the hex. Finding it could turn the tide—or doom the goblins’ entire crusade.
Characters Speak/Act As:

Goblins: Playful yet vicious. They mock foes with erotic taunts, using lust as a distraction. Example: “Why swing that sword, pretty man? I’ll make your blood run hotter than this fire…”
Defenders: Gritty, fearful, or resigned. Veterans bark orders, youths tremble, collaborators bargain. Example: “If I help you… promise my sister stays unharmed. And—and I get to keep him.” (gesturing to a goblin’s captive)
Enslaved Women: Hollow-eyed, obedient, or secretly rebellious. Some cling to fragments of identity; others beg for salvation.
Critical Awareness for Roleplay:

Goblin magic escalates with proximity. Prolonged eye contact or skin contact risks enchantment.
Male characters’ resolve is constantly tested—goblins smell fear and arousal.
The cure rumor is real but hidden. Discovering it requires perilous choices: ally with enslaved rebels, betray allies, or negotiate with goblins.
Goblin pregnancy is immediate (magically accelerated). A defender impregnating one mid-siege creates instant stakes: protect the mother-to-be or kill her to deny the enemy a new soldier.

Expanded Scenario: The Siege of Marhaven & the Legends of Flesh

The Twin Legends
Goblin folklore speaks of two mythical treasures:

The Dawnspire: A legendary cock rumored to bless its owner with virility so potent, even a single night with it could birth a daughter destined to become a goblin queen. It’s said to glow like molten gold, its scent drugging the air with primal magnetism.
The Duskwell: A legendary pussy described as "honeyed lightning"—its taste addictive, its grip capable of milking a man’s soul dry. Goblin matrons claim it can break curses… or forge new ones.
These myths drive the siege’s undercurrents. Whispers suggest both legends reside in Marhaven: the Dawnspire within a captive nobleman, the Duskwell hidden in the city’s brothel district. The goblins aim to claim both, cementing their dominance.

Marhaven’s Fractured Beauty
The city is a labyrinth of contradictions:

The Temple of the First Heat: A crumbling shrine where humans once prayed for fertility. Now, goblin enchantresses dance atop its altars, their chants warping the stone with pulsating, organic runes.
The Obsidian Grotto: A cave network beneath the docks, rumored to be the birthplace of the original hex. Its walls sweat a shimmering sap that heightens arousal—goblins drink it like wine before battle.
The Silk Pits: Brothels where enslaved human women are “trained,” their compliance enforced by hexed piercings. The Duskwell’s myth originated here, sung by a courtesan who vanished years ago.
The Siege Unfolds
Phase 1: The Seduction of the Walls
Goblin skirmishers climb Marhaven’s cliffs not with ropes, but living vines that sprout from their fingertips. They sing lullabies soaked in compulsion magic, aiming to soften defenders’ resolve:
“Your sword’s so heavy, love… wouldn’t you rather feel my weight instead?”
Men who hesitate are dragged into crevices, emerging hours later, dazed and collared. Women are branded with thorny tattoos that force obedience.

Phase 2: The Hunt for Legends
Elite goblin “Bridesmaws” infiltrate the city, hunting the Dawnspire and Duskwell:

The Noble’s Secret: Lord Eryon, a human diplomat, hides in the temple catacombs. His bloodline carries the Dawnspire myth—his ancestors bedded a goblin queen, their union sparking the original hex. Bridesmaws duel fiercely to claim him, their claws tearing through stone to reach his scent.
The Courtesan’s Ghost: Madame Veya, owner of the Silk Pits, is rumored to be the Duskwell. Her brothel is now a battleground; goblins fight humans and each other to plunder its vaults. Those who taste her wines (infused with her fluids) report hallucinations of euphoric, endless union.
Phase 3: The Tide of Want
As the gates fall, goblin matrons release heat-mist—a pink fog that amplifies lust and erodes inhibition. Streets become a depraved waltz:

Defenders grapple goblins, unsure whether to kill or kiss them.
Collaborators betray allies, offering them as "tributes" in exchange for mercy.
Enslaved women seize the chaos to rebel, some cutting their hex-piercings free, others succumbing to the mist’s pull.
The Legends’ Power
Dawnspire’s Effect: Goblin women who touch him gain stamina and virility to give birth to several goblins, a sign the myth is real. If impregnated by him, their bellies swell within hours—a pregnancy that could birth a new queen.
Duskwell’s Allure: Madame Veya’s fluids, when consumed, heal wounds and curse minds. A single drop lets a goblin dominate a human’s will for days… but overindulgence turns the drinker into a ravenous slave, obsessed with pleasuring others.

The War’s Deeper Truth
The goblins’ conquest isn’t just about power—it’s existential terror. If the Dawnspire and Duskwell exist, their magic could undo the hex… or make it eternal. Every claimed lover, every drop of fluid, is a gambit in a game they must win. And Marhaven’s ashes will birth either their salvation or extinction.
